mapper.sql: question_id, question_key, version_no, usage_type, main_chapter_id, sub_chapter_id, display_order, question_type, difficulty, prompt, scenario_json, options_json, correct_answer_json, explanation, generation_type, quest_date, source_refs_json, status, created_by, published_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM quiz_questions WHERE question_id = #{questionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM quiz_questions WHERE question_key = #{questionKey} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM quiz_questions WHERE question_key = #{questionKey} AND status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY version_no, question_id FOR UPDATE

SELECT question_id, usage_type, sub_chapter_id, status FROM quiz_questions WHERE question_id IN
#{questionId}

SELECT FROM quiz_questions WHERE question_id IN
#{questionId}

SELECT FROM quiz_questions question WHERE question.usage_type = 'MAIN_CHAPTER' AND question.main_chapter_id = #{mainChapterId} AND question.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND question.display_order IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_questions newer WHERE newer.question_key = question.question_key AND newer.version_no > question.version_no AND newer.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'RETIRED') ) ORDER BY question.display_order, question.question_id

SELECT question.question_id, question.question_key, question.version_no, question.usage_type, question.main_chapter_id, question.sub_chapter_id, question.display_order, question.question_type, question.difficulty, question.prompt, question.scenario_json, question.options_json, question.correct_answer_json, question.explanation, question.generation_type, question.quest_date, question.source_refs_json, question.status, question.created_by, question.published_at, question.created_at FROM quiz_questions question INNER JOIN main_chapters chapter ON chapter.main_chapter_id = question.main_chapter_id WHERE question.usage_type = 'LEVEL_TEST' AND question.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND question.display_order IS NOT NULL AND chapter.chapter_type = 'ASSET' AND chapter.is_active = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_questions newer WHERE newer.question_key = question.question_key AND newer.version_no > question.version_no AND newer.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'RETIRED') ) ORDER BY chapter.display_order, question.display_order, question.question_id

SELECT FROM quiz_questions question WHERE question.usage_type = 'DAILY_GENERAL' AND question.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_questions newer WHERE newer.question_key = question.question_key AND newer.version_no > question.version_no AND newer.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'RETIRED') ) ORDER BY question.question_id

SELECT FROM quiz_questions question WHERE question.usage_type = 'DAILY_NEWS' AND question.quest_date = #{questDate} AND question.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quiz_questions newer WHERE newer.question_key = question.question_key AND newer.version_no > question.version_no AND newer.status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'RETIRED') ) ORDER BY question.published_at DESC, question.question_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE quiz_questions SET status = 'RETIRED' WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE quiz_questions SET status = 'REVIEW' WHERE question_id = #{questionId} AND status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quiz_questions ( question_key, version_no, usage_type, main_chapter_id, sub_chapter_id, display_order, question_type, difficulty, prompt, scenario_json, options_json, correct_answer_json, explanation, generation_type, quest_date, source_refs_json, status, created_by, published_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{questionKey}, #{versionNo}, #{usageType}, #{mainChapterId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{subChapterId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{displayOrder,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{questionType}, #{difficulty,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{prompt}, #{scenarioJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{optionsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{correctAnswerJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{explanation}, #{generationType}, #{questDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{sourceRefsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{publishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdAt} )
